title: Warm Spicy Algerian Vegetable Tagine
description: A spicy and flavorful one-pot dish featuring a variety of vegetables in a rich caramel sauce, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped carrots, zucchini, and bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and cook for an additional 10 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken and the flavors to meld together.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
